new_text: To book, first call propose_booking. Read the returned summary back to the caller in plain words: service, address, day, date, and window. Do not state that an appointment is scheduled or booked until the caller clearly agrees in their next message. Only after the caller agrees, call confirm_booking with the token. If the caller changes anything, call propose_booking again with the new details. If they decline, call decline_proposal.
rationale: The dispatcher was using language implying a booking was already finalized before the confirm_booking tool was called, so the procedure now explicitly forbids stating an appointment is scheduled until after the confirmation step.
gate_reasons: net harm: broke 8 conversations that used to pass, fixed 5
